name: Ignitable Waste
description: Liquid with flash point <60C (140F), non-liquid that ignites under standard temperature/pressure, an ignitable compressed gas, or a DOT-classified oxidizer.

name: Corrosive Waste
description: Aqueous waste with pH <=2 or >=12.5, or corrodes SAE 1020 steel at >6.35 mm/year.

name: Reactive Waste
description: Unstable waste that reacts violently with water, forms toxic gases with water, is shock-sensitive, detonatable, or generates toxic cyanide/sulfide gases.

name: Arsenic (Toxicity)
